user.title: HA Widget Bridge
user.description:
Sets up the bridge between Home Assistant and the Android app **HA Widget Bridge**.

The widgets themselves are created in the Android app and are stored and rendered here. Every widget then shows up as a device with a content sensor and one button per widget action.

single_instance_allowed.title: Already configured
single_instance_allowed.description: HA Widget Bridge is already set up. Only one entry is needed.

already_configured.title: Already configured
already_configured.description: HA Widget Bridge is already set up.

refresh.name: Re-render widget content
refresh.description: Re-renders the content of one (or all) widgets.

widget_id.name: Widget ID
widget_id.description: ID of the widget. If omitted, all widgets are re-rendered.

press.name: Press widget button
press.description: Triggers a widget button – identical to tapping it in the Android widget.

widget_id.name: Widget ID
widget_id.description: ID of the widget the button belongs to.

button.name: Button
button.description: Key of the button inside the widget.
